title: gc beads city migrate-handoff result
description: Per-step outcome of handing a legacy GC-managed city's Dolt lifecycle to bd. ok:true means the report is complete; status carries the verdict for the city and failed counts the steps that did not succeed. The process exit code carries the verdict too.

ok.description: True when the command produced a complete report.

city.description: Absolute path of the city whose lifecycle was considered.

dry_run.description: True when nothing was stopped, started or written.

legacy_endpoint.description: host:port where gc's own Dolt server was listening, taken from gc's published runtime state.

database.description: The Dolt database gc's server serves for this city.

status.description: What happened to the city. "rolled-back" means the transfer was compensated and gc owns the lifecycle again.

failed.description: Number of steps whose status is "failed".

steps.description: One entry per step attempted, in the order they ran.

step.description: The phase or action this row reports.

actor.description: Which program performed the step. bd owns the journal and the replacement server; gc owns its own server.

phase.description: The phase bd's journal is on after this step.

error_code.description: bd's typed refusal code. Present only when a bd step failed.

detail.description: Human-readable note about what was done, would be done, or why the step was skipped.

error.description: Why this step failed. Present only with status "failed".

evidence.description: The gate outcomes bd journaled for this phase, so a refusal names which gate said no. "unavailable" is a gate this platform could not evaluate.
